intro: Hazaribagh is a plateau town in Jharkhand, greener and a little cooler than the plains, with forests and lakes around it and a long tradition of schools and colleges. Many school and colony sites here are not flat. The ground rises and falls, and rock often sits just below the soil. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment for these sites at our factory in Vasai, about 1,380 km away, and sends it to Jharkhand by road.

Uneven ground need not stop you from building a good play area. It means the levels have to be planned before the equipment is chosen. We ask for photos from several angles and a rough idea of the slope, then suggest where to cut a level platform and which pieces fit on it. Our installation team or a dealer in eastern India sets the equipment in place, grouted into the ground or self-standing on a prepared base.

sections.h: Working with a sloping or rocky site
sections.html:
Each piece of equipment and its safe play area must sit on level ground, so a slope usually becomes two or three terraces with steps or a ramp between them. Put the youngest children's pieces on the lowest level, where they are easiest to watch. Where rock lies close to the surface, foundation pits may need to be cut into it, and we plan post positions to avoid the hardest patches. Give every terrace an outlet for rainwater, since monsoon runoff on a slope moves fast.

Steps and terrace edges must stay outside every safe play area. See our 5 ft slides, or playground equipment in Ranchi.

faq.q: Can playground equipment be installed on sloping ground?
faq.a: Yes, once the slope is cut into level platforms. Each piece and its safe play area needs flat ground, so we plan the terraces with you and place the equipment on them.

faq.q: What if there is rock just under the soil?
faq.a: Foundation pits can be cut into rock, though it takes more work. We study your site photos and plan post positions to avoid the hardest areas where possible.

faq.q: Do you deliver to Hazaribagh?
faq.a: Yes. We send equipment from our Vasai factory to Hazaribagh by road. Our installation team or a dealer in eastern India installs it according to the layout drawing you approve.

intro: Hindupur lies in the far south of Andhra Pradesh, close to the Karnataka border and within easy reach of Bengaluru. It is a trading and industrial town in a dry part of the state, with schools, colleges and housing layouts whose play areas get used every day. FunPlay Systems manufactures playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 790 km away, and delivers it to Hindupur by road.

A playground is bought once but used for many years, so it is fair to ask what happens after installation. Our after-sales team handles warranty claims, replacement parts and maintenance questions. When a swing seat or a spring wears out, you can order the matching part from us instead of replacing the whole piece. Buying from the manufacturer makes that simple, because we know exactly how each model is put together.

sections.h: Looking after your equipment over the years
sections.html:
Keep the layout drawing and the invoice in one file, since together they tell us exactly which models you have. Note the date of installation. Pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry 3 years of warranty against manufacturing defects, and springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year. After that, parts can still be ordered. Hindupur's dry heat is easy on steel but hard on anything left in full sun, so check seats and ropes for wear each summer.

Our after-sales line is +91 738 530 0921. For nearby towns see playground equipment in Anantapur or Bangalore.

faq.q: Can we buy replacement parts after the warranty ends?
faq.a: Yes. Contact our after-sales team with your site details and a photo of the worn part. We will identify the matching part for your model and arrange to send it to you.

faq.q: Who do we contact for after-sales service in Hindupur?
faq.a: Our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 or aftersales@funplaysystems.com, Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM. Keep your invoice and layout drawing handy when you call.

faq.q: Is equipment for Hindupur sent from Bengaluru?
faq.a: No. All our equipment is made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, and sent by road. Installation is done by our own team or a dealer in South India.

intro: Hospet, now officially Hosapete, is the closest town to the ruins of Hampi and sits beside the Tungabhadra dam. Canals from the reservoir run through the farmland around it, and mining and steel have brought townships and schools to the area. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment here from our factory in Vasai, about 590 km away, and sends it to Karnataka by road.

Where a site lies near water, the first planning question is where to put the play area, before what to put in it. Children run straight off a slide or a swing without looking, so canals, tanks, swimming pools and deep drains must be well away from the play zone. We mark these hazards on the layout drawing from your photos and plan the equipment around them. The weather here is hot and dry for most of the year, with a short monsoon.

sections.h: Siting a play area away from water and drains
sections.html:
Choose the part of the plot furthest from canals, ponds or open drains, and put a fence or hedge between the two if the gap is small. Turn slide exits and swing arcs away from the water side, so a child coming off the equipment runs into open ground. At a hotel or resort near Hampi, keep the play area outside the pool enclosure altogether. Check that the gate of the play area does not open straight onto a road or a water channel.

See our Forestia sets for resort gardens, or playground equipment in Davanagere.

faq.q: How far should a playground be from a pool or canal?
faq.a: As far as the site allows, with a fence between them if the gap is small. We mark water bodies and drains on the layout drawing and turn slide exits and swings away from them.

faq.q: Can resorts near Hampi order playground equipment?
faq.a: Yes. Resorts, hotels, schools and townships around Hospet can order from us. We deliver from Vasai by road and install through our own team or a dealer in Karnataka.

faq.q: Which materials suit Hospet's dry heat?
faq.a: Galvanised steel frames and roto-moulded plastic parts handle long, hot summers well. Plan shade over slides and decks, and use rubber flooring instead of loose soil, which turns dusty and hard.

intro: Howrah sits across the Hooghly from Kolkata, one of the oldest industrial towns in Bengal, with dense lanes, old buildings and very little open ground. Play space here is often a small courtyard, a school terrace or the patch of land in front of a neighbourhood club. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment that fits these spaces at our factory in Vasai, about 1,640 km away, and sends it to West Bengal by road.

In a small space, the safe play area around each piece decides what fits, more than the size of the piece itself. A tall station may need a wide clear zone, while a short slide with a climber needs much less. We start from the exact measurements of your space, mark doors, pillars and drains, and suggest pieces that still leave children room to move. Howrah's humid summers and heavy monsoon also call for materials that will not rust.

sections.h: Fitting play into a small courtyard or club ground
sections.html:
Combine activities on one frame instead of placing several separate pieces. A small play station with a slide, a climber and a deck covers what three individual items would, in less ground. Spring riders fit into corners where nothing else will go. Avoid merry-go-rounds and full swing sets in tight spaces, since they need clear ground on every side. Lay rubber flooring right up to the walls, so the whole courtyard is cushioned underfoot.

See our spring riders and 3 ft slides, or playground equipment in Kolkata.

faq.q: What play equipment fits a very small courtyard?
faq.a: A small play station that combines a slide and a climber on one frame, plus a spring rider or two. Send us exact measurements and we will check that every safe play area fits.

faq.q: Can neighbourhood clubs in Howrah order from you?
faq.a: Yes. Clubs, schools, societies and municipal bodies can all order directly. We deliver from Vasai by road and install with our own team or a dealer in eastern India.

faq.q: Can playground equipment go on a school terrace?
faq.a: Often, yes. On a concrete terrace we usually choose self-standing installation so the slab is not drilled, with rubber flooring on top. Have your engineer check the railing and the load first.

intro: Hubli and Dharwad are twin cities in north Karnataka, run by one municipal corporation but quite different in character. Hubli is the commercial and railway centre, while Dharwad is known for its university, colleges and schools with large grounds. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment to both from our factory in Vasai, about 500 km away, delivered by road.

On a big school or college campus, the hard question is often where the play area should go. A ground that hosts cricket, football and sports day needs a play zone that stays out of the way of balls, runners and crowds. We look at your campus plan and suggest a corner that is safe from stray balls, easy to supervise and close to the junior classrooms. The climate here is milder than much of north Karnataka, with a good monsoon from June.

sections.h: Placing a play area on a campus with sports fields
sections.html:
Keep the play zone well clear of the boundary of any cricket or football field, or screen it with a fence or a row of trees. Avoid the edge of the running track, where crowds gather on sports day. A spot near the primary block lets teachers bring classes out quickly and watch them from a verandah. Lay a firm path to the play area so children do not cross a muddy ground after rain.

For campus play zones, see our Timeless Play structures and merry-go-rounds. For adults, see our outdoor gym equipment in Hubli-Dharwad.

faq.q: Where should a school put its playground on a large campus?
faq.a: Away from cricket and football fields and the running track, and close to the junior classrooms. We review your campus plan and suggest a spot that teachers can supervise easily.

faq.q: Do you supply both Hubli and Dharwad?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver from our Vasai factory to sites in both cities by road, and install through our own team or a dealer in Karnataka.

faq.q: Can colleges order outdoor gym equipment as well?
faq.a: Yes. Our Fun Fitness range covers outdoor gym machines for students and staff. We can plan the gym and the children's play area on the same layout drawing if you need both.

intro: Ichalkaranji, near Kolhapur, is a major powerloom centre of Maharashtra, and many of its textile businesses are family-run. When those families or their companies give back to the town, a playground for a school or a public garden is a common choice. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment for such projects at our factory in Vasai, about 340 km away, and sends it to Ichalkaranji by road. The town's humid monsoon and hot summers suit our galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts.

A donated playground works best when the donor and the receiving school or civic body agree on the details early. Who chooses the equipment, who owns it after installation and who looks after it are questions to settle before the order. We can send the layout drawing and itemised quote to both sides, so everyone approves the same plan. Many CSR donors also want their colours on the panels, which our design team can work in on request.

sections.h: Points to agree before donating a playground
sections.html:
• The exact site, its size and who has the authority to approve work on it.
  • The age group of the children who will use it.
  • Who will look after the equipment and follow the maintenance steps after handover.
  • Who keeps the warranty papers and contacts our after-sales team.

Settling these early keeps the warranty valid and the play area in use for years. You can see one of our Maharashtra installations at Raymond, Thane, or read about playground equipment in Kolhapur.

faq.q: Can a company donate playground equipment to a school through CSR?
faq.a: Yes. We work with the donor and the school together, sharing one layout drawing and quote for both to approve. Installation and handover take place at the school's site.

faq.q: Who should hold the warranty on a donated playground?
faq.a: Usually the school or body that will maintain the equipment, since the warranty depends on proper installation and maintenance. Agree this with the donor before the order is placed.

faq.q: How far is Ichalkaranji from your factory?
faq.a: About 340 km from our factory in Vasai. We deliver by road and install the equipment through our own team or a local dealer in western Maharashtra.

/outdoor-playground-equipment-manufactur.notes: The fact sheet lists Raymond, Thane as a project; I referred to it only as a Maharashtra installation in Thane, not as local work in Ichalkaranji.

intro: Imphal sits in a wide valley ringed by hills, and Manipur has a strong sporting culture, from football to the traditional game that gave the world modern polo. Children here are used to running, climbing and competing. FunPlay Systems designs playground equipment that keeps up with them, made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 2,250 km away, and sent to Manipur by road.

Older children soon lose interest in a small slide and a spring rider. For ages eight and up, we suggest equipment that tests strength and balance: climbing nets, rope bridges, balance beams and taller play towers. Younger children still need their own low pieces, placed in a separate zone. Imphal's monsoon is long and wet, so we build with galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts that do not rust or soak up water. Send us the age groups and the size of your ground to start.

sections.html:
Climbing nets and rope structures let several children climb at once, and they build grip and coordination. Balance beams and hopping pods set close to the ground offer a challenge with a low fall height. A taller tower from our NexLev series gives more height and more routes up and down. Keep the climbing zone apart from the junior area, with its own safe play area and rubber flooring underneath. Play rope carries our 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects.

See our Net Rock Climber and NexLev Escapade structures, or our outdoor gym equipment in Imphal.

faq.q: What playground equipment suits children over eight?
faq.a: Climbing nets, rope bridges, balance pieces and taller towers, which test strength and balance. We place them in a separate zone from the low equipment used by younger children.

faq.q: Can you deliver playground equipment to Manipur?
faq.a: Yes. We send orders from our Vasai factory to Imphal by road. Installation is carried out by our own team or a dealer who serves the Northeast.

faq.q: Do rope nets last in Imphal's wet climate?
faq.a: Play rope is made for outdoor use and carries a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Check knots and fixings after the monsoon and report any fraying to our after-sales team.

intro: Itanagar is the capital of Arunachal Pradesh, spread over forested hills in the foothills of the eastern Himalaya. Government offices, schools and residential colonies here need play areas, and almost every site sits on sloping ground. FunPlay Systems manufactures playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 2,280 km away, and sends it to Arunachal Pradesh by road.

Visitors from other states need an Inner Line Permit to enter Arunachal Pradesh, and that includes our installation crew. We plan for the permit when we schedule your installation, so keep some time for it in your project plan. The last part of the road climbs through the hills, which limits how large a structure can reach your site. Tell us about the approach road, and we will suggest equipment that can be carried up and assembled on site.

sections.html:
Send us photos of the approach as well as the site itself. Where trucks cannot reach the gate, individual pieces and compact play stations are easier to carry in than a large tower. Itanagar gets heavy rain for much of the year, so the level platform for the play area needs firm edges and a drain along its uphill side. Grouted foundations hold better than self-standing bases on soft, wet hill soil. Government buyers can share the layout with their engineers before work starts.

See our Double Swing and see-saws, or playground equipment in Jorhat.

faq.q: Does your installation team need a permit for Arunachal Pradesh?
faq.a: Yes. Visitors from outside the state need an Inner Line Permit, and that applies to our crew as well. We plan for it when scheduling your installation.

faq.q: Can large play structures be taken to hill sites in Itanagar?
faq.a: It depends on the approach road. Where access is narrow or steep, we suggest individual pieces and compact play stations that can be carried in and assembled on site.

faq.q: Who installs playground equipment in Arunachal Pradesh?
faq.a: Our installation team or a dealer who serves the Northeast. The equipment is made in Vasai and sent by road, then installed according to the layout drawing you approve.

intro: Jabalpur stands on the Narmada, with the marble rocks of Bhedaghat close by, and it has long been a cantonment city with defence establishments and their housing estates. Many of our enquiries here come from estate offices, schools and colonies that employ their own maintenance staff. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment for these buyers at our factory in Vasai, about 840 km away, and delivers it by road.

Where a site has a permanent maintenance team, the handover matters as much as the installation. Those staff will look after the equipment for years after our crew has left. So at handover we take them through the maintenance steps, show which parts to check and explain what the warranty expects of them. Jabalpur's hot summers and strong monsoon make that routine a big part of how long the equipment lasts.

sections.h: What your maintenance staff should know
sections.html:
Bolts and fixings on every piece should be checked and tightened on a fixed schedule. Springs, swing hangers and bearings carry a 1-year warranty and wear fastest, so they need the closest watch. Plastic parts and slides only need washing with water and a soft cloth, never harsh scrubbing pads or solvents. Keep a simple register of each check and every part replaced. Before and after the monsoon, inspect the foundations for any loosening.

For estate parks, see our Joy Ridge play station, or playground equipment in Katni.

faq.q: What maintenance does playground equipment need?
faq.a: Regular checks of bolts and moving parts, washing of plastic parts with water and a soft cloth, and an inspection of foundations around the monsoon. We explain these steps to your staff at handover.

faq.q: Can cantonment and defence estates order from you?
faq.a: Yes. Estate offices, schools and colonies can order directly. We share a layout drawing and itemised quote for approval, then manufacture at Vasai, deliver by road and install.

faq.q: Why keep a maintenance register?
faq.a: It shows when each part was checked or replaced, which helps your staff plan the next round. It is also useful when you contact our after-sales team about a warranty claim. A copy of the register also helps a new caretaker pick up the routine.

intro: Jaipur's summers are fierce, and from May into June dust storms can sweep in from the desert with little warning. Housing societies, schools, hotels and public gardens across the city still want outdoor play areas that children can use for most of the year. FunPlay Systems designs and builds playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 890 km away, and sends it to Rajasthan by road.

Two things decide whether a play area in Jaipur gets used: shade in the hot months and firm fixing against strong winds. We plan both on the layout drawing. Shade can come from trees, a building, or a gazebo or pergola from our Garden Decor range. Each piece is fixed firmly, grouted into the ground on open sites or self-standing on a prepared base, so a storm cannot shift it.

sections.h: Shade and wind on an open Jaipur site
sections.html:
Plan shade first for the slides and decks, since they take the sun most directly. A pergola over a seating area gives parents a cool place to wait near the play zone. Keep light shade sails away from the play area unless they are engineered for wind, because a dust storm can tear loose fittings. After a storm, sweep sand off slides and decks before children use them, since grit wears the plastic. Rubber flooring is far easier to clear than loose sand.

See our Pyramid Pergola and Comfy Gazebo, or playground equipment in Ajmer.

faq.q: How do you fix playground equipment against dust storms?
faq.a: On open ground we grout each post into a concrete base, and on paved areas we use a self-standing base suited to the site. Check bolts after strong winds and clean off sand before use.

faq.q: Can you supply shade structures with the playground?
faq.a: Yes. Our Garden Decor range includes gazebos and pergolas. We place them on the same layout drawing as the play equipment and can send them in the same order.

faq.q: Do you supply housing societies in Jaipur?
faq.a: Yes. Societies, schools, hotels and public gardens in Jaipur can order from us. We deliver from Vasai by road and install with our own team or a dealer in Rajasthan.

intro: Jalandhar is known across India for making sports goods, and its schools and colonies take outdoor play seriously. The city has very hot summers and cold, foggy winters, so play equipment here has to be comfortable and safe in both. FunPlay Systems manufactures playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,360 km away, and sends it to Punjab by road.

Winter is the season buyers in Punjab most often forget to plan for. On a December morning, bare metal handrails and seats are cold to the touch, and fog or dew leaves every surface damp. Roto-moulded slides, seats and panels do not feel as cold as metal, and they stay cooler in the summer sun too. We take both seasons into account when we suggest equipment for your site and mark the safe play area on the layout.

sections.html:
Choose roto-moulded seats on swings and see-saws instead of bare metal, which children will avoid in winter. After heavy fog or dew, let the sun dry the equipment before morning play. Rubber flooring stays less slippery than tiles or polished stone when damp. Place the play area where it gets morning sun in winter, and add summer shade with a deciduous tree or a pergola. That way the same spot works in both seasons.

See our Curve Post Swing and Rainbow See Saw, or playground equipment in Ludhiana.

faq.q: Does playground equipment get slippery in Jalandhar's winter fog?
faq.a: Any surface gets damp in fog or dew. Let the sun dry the equipment before morning play, and use rubber flooring, which stays less slippery than tiles or stone when wet.

faq.q: Which seat material is better for cold weather?
faq.a: Roto-moulded plastic seats do not feel as cold as bare metal on a winter morning. They also stay cooler in the summer sun, so they suit Punjab's weather in both seasons.

faq.q: Do you deliver playground equipment to Punjab?
faq.a: Yes. We send equipment from our Vasai factory to Jalandhar and other Punjab cities by road, and install it with our own team or a dealer in North India.

intro: Jalgaon is the main town of Khandesh, known for its bananas and cotton, with the Ajanta caves a short drive away. At about 330 km from our Vasai factory, it is one of the nearer district towns for FunPlay Systems. We supply playground equipment to schools, housing societies and municipal gardens across Jalgaon district, sent by road and installed on site.

Buyers often ask what actually happens on the day our crew arrives. Knowing in advance helps, so the site and your staff are ready. Our installation team or a local dealer unloads the packed parts, checks them against the order, marks the post positions from the approved layout and begins assembly. Jalgaon's summers are very hot, so an early start is easier on everyone. Water and a power point within reach of the site also save time.

sections.html:
1. The crew unloads the parts and checks them against the packing list with your representative.
  2. Post positions are marked on the ground from the approved layout drawing.
  3. For grouted pieces, pits are dug and the posts set in concrete. Self-standing pieces are assembled on their base.
  4. The crew checks each piece, and the site is handed over with maintenance notes.

Keep children away until the concrete has set, which takes longer in cool or damp weather. For a Maharashtra installation, see our Raymond, Thane project, or playground equipment in Dhule.

faq.q: What do we need to arrange for installation day?
faq.a: A cleared site, a person to check the delivery against the packing list, and access to water and power. Keep children and vehicles away from the area while the crew works.

faq.q: How soon can children use grouted equipment?
faq.a: Only after the concrete foundations have set properly. Our crew will tell you when the equipment is ready, and the area should stay closed off until then. Fencing the area off with tape or barricades is the simplest way to keep children out.

faq.q: Do you supply schools across Jalgaon district?
faq.a: Yes. Schools, societies and gardens across the district can order from us. We deliver from Vasai by road and install with our own team or a local dealer.

/outdoor-playground-equipment-manufactur.notes: Raymond, Thane is referenced as a Maharashtra project in Thane, not as local work.
